Definition: a form of G2017; to begin to grow light:--begin to dawn, X draw on.
BiblicalUsage: Epiphosko means to begin to dawn, to draw on — and Matthew says, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the sepulchre; and Luke says the sabbath drew on as they laid Jesus in the tomb.
TheologicalSignificance: The sabbath drawing on over a sealed tomb, and the first day dawning on an empty one: the dawning holds the hinge of history.
RelatedEvents: The Resurrection; The Burial of Jesus
